question: Regarding 'Hit and Run' cases under Section 106(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (BNS), what is the maximum punishment if an offender causes death by rash and negligent driving and fails to inform a 'police officer' or 'Magistrate'?

options.text: Imprisonment up to 10 years and a fine
Imprisonment up to 5 years and a fine
Imprisonment up to 7 years and a fine

solution:
The correct answer is __**Imprisonment up to 10 years and a fine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Under the **Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (BNS)**, the provision for 'Hit and Run' cases is outlined in **Section 106(2)**. This section covers instances where an offender, due to rash and negligent driving, causes **death** and **fails to report** the incident to a police officer or a magistrate.
 
• The maximum punishment for such an act includes **imprisonment up to 10 years** along with a **monetary fine**.
 
• This provision emphasizes the seriousness of offenses related to negligent driving and the importance of **reporting incidents** to law enforcement authorities.
 
• The law aims to deter individuals from fleeing accident scenes and encourages responsible behavior among drivers.
